public abstract class Idrak.Abstraction.Training.LearningRateScheduler
  protected LearningRateScheduler(Idrak.Abstraction.Training.Optimizer optimizer)
  protected abstract float Compute(int epoch)
  protected void Initialize()
  public Idrak.Abstraction.Training.Optimizer Optimizer { get; }
  public float BaseLearningRate { get; }
  public int Epoch { get; }
  public void Step()

public abstract class Idrak.Abstraction.Training.Optimizer : System.IDisposable
  protected Optimizer(System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<Idrak.Abstraction.Tensor> parameters, float learningRate)
  protected bool GradientsZeroed { get; set; }
  protected float GradientScale { get; set; }
  protected static Idrak.Abstraction.Tensor CreateState(Idrak.Abstraction.Tensor parameter)
  protected static Idrak.Abstraction.Tensor CreateState(System.ReadOnlySpan<int> shape, Idrak.Abstraction.Device device)
  protected virtual bool ScalesGradientsInStep { get; }
  protected void ApplyCoupledWeightDecay(float decay)
  protected void ApplyDecoupledWeightDecay(float decay)
  public System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<Idrak.Abstraction.Tensor> Parameters { get; }
  public abstract void Step()
  public double ClipGradientNorm(float maxNorm)
  public double GradientNorm()
  public float LearningRate { get; set; }
  public virtual void ClipAndStep(float maxNorm)
  public virtual void Dispose()
  public void ClipGradientNormOnDevice(float maxNorm)
  public void ZeroGrad()
